1580-2403-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1580-2403-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Moonlit Wake and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1251-2023-4770-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

955-5078-6766-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1453-4694-5686-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
You control a permanent that is boosting the toughness of all your creatures by at least 1, or that is giving a creature a +1/+1 counter as it enters the battlefield.
You control at least one additional creature.
1453-4694-5686-7306.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat from step 1.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
The Blood token enters the battlefield as a 0/0 creature due to March of the Machines, and will have its toughness boosted by the permanent specified in the pre-requisites to prevent it from dying.
Repeat.

539-728-3249-5553.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-3249-5553.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Greedy Freebooter, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

4913-5233-5310-7857.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, causing you to draw a card and put Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Bloodghast and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Zimone and Dina.
Repeat.

3375-4399-4518-5468.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Kambal trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kambal trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-4399-4518-5468.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

3490-4050-6097-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2092-2757-4669-5140.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Hajar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Hajar, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Hajar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Selvala.
Repeat.

1379-3259-4742-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
1379-3259-4742-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1379-3259-4742-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

539-2713-4552-7251.description:
Activate Vindictive Warden by paying {0} due to Zirda and Blossoming Tortoise (as Vindictive Warden is a land due to Ashaya), dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

3621-5330-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.
3621-5330-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can just do step 1 repeatedly.

2034-3490-4017-6458.description:

Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

5686-6199-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Marionette Apprentice.
When Marionette Apprentice dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Marionette Apprentice enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2653-4826-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2653-4826-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer token enters, it triggers, creating a Mutavault land token that enters untapped due to Archelos.
When the Mutavault token enters, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa trigger.
Holding priority, activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3480-5299-5921-5970--112.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
3480-5299-5921-5970--112.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
3480-5299-5921-5970--112.notes: The chosen anthem must increase the toughness of the Mirror Room token so it does not die as it enters the battlefield.

You control seven or more lands with different names.
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-3534-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

914-1251-3036.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1251-3036.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it, adding {R}.

1283-2585-4222-4785.notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Dynaheir.
1283-2585-4222-4785.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Dynaheir by tapping it, copying the next ability that you activate that costs at least four mana this turn.

Resolve Grim Monolith's ability from step 4, untapping it.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Dynaheir.
Repeat from step 2.
